message:
fix(keepalive-multi r1): the table refuses a PC whose own park is unfenced; a dropped PC's error stays shown

SessionTable::Activate checked the OTHER entries' park only: a PC tapped again while its
own pause was still confirming got a binding for a still-inhibited session (only the
screen's anyConfirming -> Wait stood in the way). The table now refuses it too.
session_table_test 47/0; with the guard disabled the new case fails (45/2, exit 1).
The PC on screen ending on its own (peer lost) left no error on the screen: the native
reap removes the entry before the screen read its last error. The last error read while
it was on screen is kept and shown until the next PC is put on screen (0.2.30 showed its
one session's error).
km_r5 (fixture APK 647fa32f): 20/20, and routing from the hosts' own logs -- a tap and
화질 BEST with A on screen reach A only (2 input-trace + runtime-config 6000000; B
nothing), a tap with B on screen reaches B only (A nothing). Steady park 0 encoded / 0
video datagrams on both hosts.
